head_html:
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
<style>
.mc-grad{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#0ea5e9);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;color:transparent}
.mc-reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:all .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.mc-reveal.mc-on{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.mc-btn{position:relative;overflow:hidden;z-index:1}
.mc-btn::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:-100%;width:100%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.6),transparent);transition:left .6s ease;z-index:-1}
.mc-btn:hover::before{left:100%}
@keyframes mc-pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(79,70,229,.35)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 18px rgba(79,70,229,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(79,70,229,0)}}
.mc-pulse{animation:mc-pulse 2.2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.6,1) infinite}
.mc-play{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:80px;height:80px;background:#4f46e5;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;transition:.3s;z-index:3;box-shadow:0 0 0 12px rgba(79,70,229,.2)}
.mc-wrapper:hover .mc-play{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.08);box-shadow:0 0 0 18px rgba(79,70,229,.2)}
.mc-tick{color:#10b981;font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:700}
.mc-cross{color:#ef4444;font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:700}
@keyframes mc-slide-up{to{transform:translateY(0)}}
.mc-sticky{transform:translateY(100%);animation:mc-slide-up .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) forwards 1.4s}
.mc-faq{background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:15px;overflow:hidden}
.mc-faq-q{padding:20px 25px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:700;color:#0f172a;text-align:left;font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif}
.mc-faq-q::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.mc-faq-q::after{content:'↓';color:#4f46e5;font-size:20px;line-height:1;transition:transform .3s;margin-left:16px}
details[open].mc-faq .mc-faq-q::after{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.mc-faq-a{color:#475569;font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.6;padding:0 25px 20px;font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif}
</style>
